name: zeta-desktop
description: Electron client for the Zeta app-server protocol

scripts.predev: corepack pnpm run prepare:output && node ../build/desktop/resources/syncGeneratedResources.ts && node ../build/desktop/prepareDevPackage.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node ../build/desktop/verifySandboxPreload.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && vite build --config ../build/vite/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:main: corepack pnpm run test:build-tools && corepack pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:editor: corepack pnpm run test:editor:unit && corepack pnpm run test:editor:browser
scripts.pretest:smoke:ui: corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:smoke:ui:debug: corepack pnpm run pretest:smoke:ui && playwright test --project=electron-ui --debug
scripts.pretest:smoke:browser: corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:smoke:browser:debug: corepack pnpm run pretest:smoke:browser && cross-env ZETA_PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=disconnected playwright test --project=browser-ui --debug
scripts.pretest:smoke:browser:full: corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:smoke:desktop: corepack pnpm run build && node ../build/desktop/prepareDevPackage.ts && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:smoke:desktop:debug: corepack pnpm run pretest:smoke:desktop && playwright test --project=electron-app-server --debug
scripts.pretest:app: corepack pnpm run build && node ../build/desktop/prepareDevPackage.ts && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:app:pdf-corpus: corepack pnpm run build && node ../build/desktop/prepareDevPackage.ts && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node ../build/desktop/verifySandboxPreload.ts && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host,server-host "vite --config ../build/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ZETA_DEV_SERVER_HOST_RELOAD=1 ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/lib/watch/watchElectron.ts" "node ../build/lib/watch/watchServerHost.ts --skip-initial"
scripts.dev:ui: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node ../build/desktop/verifySandboxPreload.ts && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host "vite --config ../build/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ZETA_DESKTOP_UI_ONLY=1 ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/lib/watch/watchElectron.ts"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ZETA_DEV_SERVER_HOST_RELOAD=1 ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/lib/watch/watchElectron.ts
